subject: Discovery recap: CedarPoint private hosting constraints + next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kevin Mercer <kevin@cedarpointhealth.org>; Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@cedarpointhealth.org>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap: CedarPoint private hosting constraints + next steps

Hi Kevin / Alyssa —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick written recap so we have the same priorities and next actions from the discovery call: feel free to correct or add anything.

Key business goals you shared
- Securely run PII-sensitive triage and discharge summarization in production (latency target: <200ms p50 for short prompts).
- Remove PHI tokens from logs and ensure customer-managed key control for persisted model artifacts.
- Keep inference within your VPC for data residency and auditing needs.

Primary constraints and technical notes you confirmed
- Required: VPC-private deployment (no public ingress), optional air-gap for on-prem DR site.
- KMS requirement: HSM-backed CMK with rotation policy managed by CedarPoint.
- Network constraints: strict outbound egress rules; only specific ports to Redwood control plane allowed via a jump host.
- Hardware: preference for a dedicated single-node GPU pool initially (NVIDIA H100 preferred).

Success criteria for an initial pilot
- Model serving inside CedarPoint VPC with KMS integration for keys.
- End-to-end PII masking and audit log export to your SIEM (Splunk).
- <30% dev ops lift from your infra team for the initial 6-week pilot.

Open questions we need to resolve
1) Can your security team share an initial network egress allowlist and the IP range for the jump host?
2) Procurement: any standard SOW clauses we need to pre-populate for Private deployments?
3) What level of audit log retention is required (90/180/365 days)?

Immediate next steps (owner -> due)
- Marissa -> Send mutual action plan and templates by end of day (attached).
- Karthik -> Schedule a 60-min technical deep-dive with your infra/security next week to map ports, KMS endpoints, and cert provisioning (proposed: Tue 7/20).
- Kevin/Alyssa -> Share the network inventory and a contact for the HSM/KMS team (target: 7/22).
- Procurement -> If you can, email procurement@redwoodinference.com a procurement contact and any redline checklist (target: 7/23).

Attachments included
- mutual-action-plan-CPH-20270715.xlsx (MMP with milestones and owner matrix)
- network-inventory-template.pdf (template for CIDR blocks, firewall rules, and jump host details)

If this looks right I will lock the MMP milestones and drop calendar invites for the tech deep-dive.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

From: Kevin Mercer <kevin@cedarpointhealth.org>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@cedarpointhealth.org>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: CedarPoint private hosting constraints + next steps

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. This matches our notes and is helpful. A few clarifications and answers to your open questions:

1) Network allowlist: I'll send a preliminary CSV with our CIDRs and the jump host IP by EOD Monday. We cannot expose any direct control-plane endpoint to the public internet; the jump host is the only permitted outbound.
2) Procurement: we usually require an SOC 2 Type II attestation and a BAA for PHI workloads. Procurement will review your sample SOW; please include references to data handling and incident response SLAs.
3) Audit log retention: we need 365 days for now, but can negotiate shorter retention for non-PII logs.

Two additional asks:
- Can Redwood support vault integration (HashiCorp Vault) for dynamic secrets or must keys be static CMKs?
- For the air-gap scenario, are there recommended hardware specs you prefer for offline inference (GPU counts, NVMe sizing)?

We'll confirm the team for the tech deep-dive. Tentatively, Tue 7/20 10:00 AM PT works.

Thanks — Kevin
Kevin Mercer
Director of Infrastructure, CedarPoint Health
kevin@cedarpointhealth.org | +1 (503) 555-0102

Subject: Re: Discovery recap: CedarPoint private hosting constraints + next steps

Kevin —

Appreciate the quick reply and the policy pointers. Short answers:
- Vault: yes, Redwood Private supports integration with HashiCorp Vault for dynamic secrets; for pilot we can validate a Vault transit/PKI flow or use your HSM-backed CMK. Karthik and Dev will outline the integration options in the tech deep-dive.
- Air-gap hardware guidance: for an offline single-node pilot we typically recommend 1x H100 (or equivalent), 512GB system memory, and 4TB NVMe for cache/checkpoints; we will share a more detailed spec sheet in the deep-dive.

I've uploaded an MMP with milestone dates and initial owners to the Drive link below and attached the same XLS. I will send calendar invites for Tue 7/20 10:00 AM PT to kick off the tech session (Karthik will lead).

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-MAP
HubSpot record: HS-98765

Next owners/dates (revised)
- CedarPoint (Kevin) -> network inventory + HSM contact by 7/22
- Redwood (Karthik) -> technical runbook + integration options by 7/19
- Procurement (CedarPoint) -> SOW comments by 7/23

If you want us to limit the initial scope (e.g., skip air-gap and focus on VPC + KMS for pilot) say the word and we'll pare the MMP accordingly.

Regards,

Marissa
